name: flatbuffers
description: FlatBuffers from the OyiGames fork (upstream 25.12.19 plus the C# Verifier identifier fix, trimmed to C++ and C#; ADR-0023). FlatBuffers is a cross platform serialization library architected for maximum memory efficiency. It allows you to directly access serialized data without parsing/unpacking it first, while still having great forwards/backwards compatibility.
